What should the adult talk about?

  • Talk about your favourite animal, hobby, sport, music or food.
  • Try to keep what you say as factual as possible.
  • Talk for a couple of minutes – you want to say enough that your child can’t just write everything down.


What should the child do?

  1. While your adult is talking, listen carefully and make a short note of any important facts. This will help you remember them later.
  2. When your adult has finished talking, write your summary. Here are some important things to remember:
    • You should write in your own words.
    • It should be short, maybe three sentences.
    • You should include all the most important information.
